items.title: Build Live Apps in Cursor
items.excerpt: Build and deploy web apps directly in Cursor with cloud agents handling hosting, database, auth, and deployment.
items.rationale: Primary-source release: Cursor now hosts and deploys live apps, with cloud agents handling the database and auth, so designer-built prototypes can ship without a separate backend setup.

items.title: Chaos brings AI deeper into V-Ray Collection
items.excerpt: Chaos brings AI deeper into V-Ray Collection. Features include in-product AI guidance, MCP support and 3D asset generation
items.rationale: New V-Ray Collection release adds in-product AI guidance, MCP support and 3D asset generation, changing how viz artists drive the renderer.

items.title: Qonic AI launches inside BIM platform
items.excerpt: Qonic AI inside BIM platform. Agents work directly inside the model, letting users find, check, fix and create BIM data using plain language
items.rationale: Launch of Qonic AI agents that work directly inside the BIM model, so users can find, check, fix and create model data in plain language.

items.title: Meta's Muse AI can create custom 'spaces' for the version of the app you need right now
items.excerpt: Meta's Muse assistant can now build 'spaces' - custom app-like experiences such as a shopping hub or school dashboard created by describing them, kept live with data from connected apps.
items.rationale: New Muse feature generates app-like 'spaces' on demand from a description: generative UI reaching a mass consumer audience, which product designers will need to account for.

items.title: Agents Sucked At UI (Until Today)
items.excerpt: Theo breaks down how he made Claude Opus 'hill climb' on UI output until agents finally produced the frontend design he wanted.
items.rationale: Hands-on technique for iterating an agent on its UI output until the frontend design holds up, which design-engineers can reuse in their own agent loops.

dedup.note: Exact-URL check against published_urls.json: none of the 5 picks appear in design or gadgets (gadgets has other Meta Muse stories, but not the 'spaces' feature). Dropped as duplicates: (1) Figma YouTube 'Speed up design system documentation with the Figma agent' is a tutorial rehash of the Figma agent design-system workflow already published 2026-10-24 (https://www.figma.com/blog/how-to-put-your-design-system-to-work-with-the-figma-agent/), with no new release. (2) Chaos 'brings AI design exploration into Enscape' comes from the same outlet on the same day as the V-Ray piece and covers the same Chaos AI rollout, so only the V-Ray article is kept. (3) Cluster c5: The AI Advantage video and the MindStudio Claude Design animation guide are one story (transcript to animated overlays with Claude Design). Both are how-tos, so neither was picked. Not picked on score or diversity: Figma Field/Friedberg conversation (interview, no release), UXC essays x2 (commentary), dev.to Figma MCP prep (how-to, close to the 10-27 UXC MCP library article), dev.to Lovable build and Design to Code #10 (personal accounts), DLSS 5 Hogwarts (game-side, and design ran the DLSS 5 launch on 09-03), Firebase Studio sunset (developer platform), NVIDIA Omniverse agents (closest earlier story is the 10-10 SimReady piece), Pika H3 Flex and Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash (secondary MindStudio pricing write-ups, and movies may also want them), Bentley MCP (analysis), DEVELOP3D opinion. Every history_match (related band) was reviewed: Qonic vs Snaptrude and Cursor live apps vs Runway Dev are different products, and Muse spaces vs Claude Duet are different features, so all are new.
